intent: Implement LedgerController making the T1 tests pass, exactly per ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @RestController /api/v1/ledger read-only (open-host query endpoints). GET /records/{recordId}/revisions -> Flux<RevisionResponse> in revision order; GET /records/{recordId}/latest -> Mono<RevisionResponse>, 404 ResponseStatusException when absent; GET /history?deviceId&metricType&from&to -> Flux<RevisionResponse> ordered by t_device. Nested record RevisionResponse(UUID recordId, int revisionNumber, String reason, String deviceId, String metricType, double value, Instant deviceTimestamp, Instant ingressTimestamp, String validationStatus, Instant recordedAt) with static from(EventRevision). Constructor(TelemetryHistoryQueryService). No write endpoints.

methods.signature: Flux<LedgerController.RevisionResponse> history(String deviceId, TelemetrySample.MetricType metricType, Instant from, Instant to)
